questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition', B denotes 'multiplication', C denotes 'subtraction', and D denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following equation?

11 C 5 A (9 D 3) B 2 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Means
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

The given expression : 11 C 5 A (9 D 3) B 2 = ?

After interchanging the symbols by mathematical operators the expression is as follows : 11 - 5 + (9 ÷ 3) × 2

= 11 - 5 + __**(9 ÷ 3)**__ × 2

= 11 - 5 + __**3 × 2**__

= __**11**__ - 5 __**+ 6**__

= __**17 - 5**__

= **12**

Hence, the correct answer is **"12".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some T are M.

II. No T is Y.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some M are not Y.

II. Some M are T.

III. All M are Y.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8673101b81a219f525beae69f7b345dd582b3f08a2d4e66e7afc35c02c8282.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some M are not Y → True (As Some T are M and No T is Y so, Some M are not Y is definitely true)

II. Some M are T → True (As Some T are M so, Some M are T is true)

III. All M are Y → False (As Some T are M and No T is Y so, All M are Y is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follows".**

questions.question: Rajesh, Ramesh, Suresh, Mukesh and Pritesh are five friends who scored different marks in a test. Two people scored between Rajesh and Mukesh. Ramesh scored the highest marks. Pritesh scored more than Suresh. Who scored the fourth highest marks?
questions.solution:
As per the given information:

1. Ramesh scored the highest marks.

Ramesh > _ > _ > _ > _ 

2. Two people score between Rajesh and Mukesh.

**Case 1:**

Ramesh > Rajesh > _ > _ > Mukesh

**Case 2:**

Ramesh > Mukesh > _ > _ > Rajesh

3. Pritesh scored more than Suresh.

Case 1:

Ramesh > Rajesh > Pritesh > Suresh > Mukesh

Case 2:

Ramesh > Mukesh > Pritesh > Suresh > Rajesh

Here, **'Suresh' **scored the fourth highest marks.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Mumbai : Maharashtra :: Chennai : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First word is the capital city of the second word.

Mumbai : Maharashtra → Mumbai is the capital city of Maharashtra.

Similarly,

Chennai : ? → Chennai is the capital city of Tamil Nadu.

Hence, '**Tamil Nadu**' is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

• Rational : logical → Rational is the synonym of Logical.

Similarly,

 
• Scanty : ? → Scanty is the synonym of less.

Hence, '**Less**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

42 : 56 :: 24 : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : (1st number ÷ 6) = (2nd number ÷ 8)**

So,

 
• 42 : 56

42 ÷ 6 = 56 ÷ 8

7 = 7 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 
• 24 : ?

24 ÷ 6 = ? ÷ 8

4 × 8 = ?

**? = 32**

Hence, **"32"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

5 ÷ 4 × 8 = 7 - 3
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given statement : 5 ÷ 4 × 8 = 7 - 3 

According to the question, after interchanging the signs:

So,

__
 
• Option - (1) : ÷ and -

Given statement : 5 ÷ 4 × 8 = 7 - 3

After interchanging:

5 - **4 × 8**__ = __**7 ÷ 3**__ 

__**5 - 32**__ = 2.33

-27 ≠ 2.33 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (2) : = and -

Given statement : 5 ÷ 4 × 8 = 7 - 3 

After interchanging:

**5 ÷ 4**__ × 8 - 7 = 3

__**1.25 **____**× 8**__ - 7 = 3

__**10 -**____** 7**__ = 3

3 = 3 (LHS = RHS)

__
 
• Option - (3) : × and −

Given statement : 5 ÷ 4 × 8 = 7 - 3 

After interchanging:

**5 ÷ 4**__ - 8 = __**7 × 3**__ 

__**1.25 - 8**__ = 21

-6.75 ≠ 21 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (4) : ÷ and =

Given statement : 5 ÷ 4 × 8 = 7 - 3 

After interchanging:

5 = 4 × **8 ÷ 7**__ - 3 

5 = __**4 × 1.14**__ - 3

5 = __**4.56 - 3**__

5 ≠ 1.56 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
